dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: #Paimon! {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, it's you, Pahsiv! Nice to see you again! What are you doing around here?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Pahsiv... working! Pahsiv... tired! Pahsiv... lie down!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? You're... working?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Foggy Forest Branch... Foggy Forest Branch... very throw!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What's a Foggy Forest Branch?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Foggy Forest Branch... Information!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Willow, collect. Fog, handle. Spring, send.

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Foggy Forest Branch... Mist information!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So you mean it's information about the Foggy Forest Path?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Foggy Forest Branch... very throw! Very many places!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Pahsiv... searching! Pahsiv... tired! Pahsiv... eat! Pahsiv... lie down!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Foggy Forest Branch... Very not many! But boxes, very many!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: #Ah... Thank you Paimon, thank you {NICKNAME}, here!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You found us a treasure chest again?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Pahsiv! Box, treasure, flower, shiny, sweet, very many!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, so there's other stuff, too? Y'know, Pahsiv, you're real nice, but it'd be bad if we kept taking your stuff for free. Why don't we exchange things instead?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Ex... change?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's right! We're friends, and friends should exchange gifts in earnest with one another!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, we're gonna help you find your Foggy Forest Branches, and exchange those for your stuff. Whaddya say?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And we can get you some stuff to eat, too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Right, we can do that! You're having a hard time by yourself, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Eat! Tidalga! Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You like Tidalga?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Tidalga! Tidalga! Tidalga Tidalga Tidalga!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, does that mean you eat five meals, or five Tidalga a day? Uh... Wow, you might have Paimon beat for appetite!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, what about the Branches, then? Can we find 'em by following the Foggy Forest Path?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Melusine...

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Foggy Forest Branch... very throw! Very many places! Very Erinnyes!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The Branches are all over Erinnyes, then?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: #Smart {NICKNAME}! Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Foggy Path has flowers. Branches, also flowers!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Branch, branch, branch, branch, branch, branch... Number!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. Ooh, Paimon gets it now. The Branches can be found in places with the same flowers as the Foggy Forest Path, and there are six locations, right?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Smart Paimon! Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, guess we're all clear now, eh? Make sure you rest up, Pahsiv. Just leave this to us!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: #Paimon, {NICKNAME}, good thing! So, slowly, slowly! Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: #Paimon! {NICKNAME}!

response.speaker: Pahsiv
response.text: Tidalga! Tidalga! Tidalga Tidalga Tidalga! Swap!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's nice to see you so happy, Pahsiv, but uh, what are we gonna use these for, again?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Foggy Forest Branch, very many useful! New Valet, very many useful!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So this is something New Valet needs?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Pahsiv! Branch... Information!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: #Ah... Thank you, Paimon, thank you, {NICKNAME}. Treasure, give!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've brought you some Tidalga.

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Tidalga! Tidalga! Tidalga Tidalga Tidalga! Swap!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: #Thanks, {NICKNAME}! Thanks, Tidalga!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Boxes... Treasures... Melusine...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, Pahsiv, did we run you all outta stuff?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Pahsiv... go out! Pahsiv... find!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's fine if you don't have anything with you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's right. We can just give you Tidalga anyway!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Melusine!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: #Paimon, friend... earnest! {NICKNAME}, friend... earnest! So... swap!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, well, alright then. How long will you be out, Pahsiv? Are we gonna see you around?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: See... around?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, that's how we express the desire to meet again!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "See you around" is how we say goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's right. We did say previously that we'll teach you how to say goodbye, didn't we? Well, why don't you try saying it?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Good... bye?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, do you not know what that means?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Well, you can consider it a sort of exchange or swap, too. Kinda like swapping one tomorrow for another...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You take a bit of your tomorrow and give it to us, and we'll give a bit of ours to you — and that's how we'll meet again! What do you think? Get it now?

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: Swap tomorrow... for tomorrow! Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, looks like you get it! In that case, let's say "see you around" for now — that way, we'll definitely meet again!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: See you around! Pahsiv!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See ya!

dialogues.speaker: Pahsiv
dialogues.text: #See you, {NICKNAME}! See you, Paimon!
